messages.subject: Project Indigo - ready for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

We're there. Final terms: £4.5m upfront (£2m on completion, £2.5m on the first anniversary), 4.5% running royalty, £750k minimum from year 2, £350k transfer fee, 150% liability cap, 12-year term. The disclosure letter and board minutes are ready. Tessandri is targeting completion on 16 February.

Could you arrange for the board minutes to be approved at your board on the 10th? I'll attend by phone.

Kind regards,
James
